verdict.rationale: IP India runs Comprehensive e-Filing Services, so the question of how users sign in fairly applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack describes the sign-in path: no credential MFA, OTP, digital signature, biometric, in-person or mailed-PIN requirement is documented. The public, account-free status lookup (ip-india-supp-2) is an adjacent feature and does not show how an authorized human authenticates for filing.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
